source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Carefully read the instructions within 'safety_check_instructions' if you are not sure how to apply these instructions and identify the cause of the failure.
3. If it is not obvious to you why the test has failed, please use the 'Record failed safety check' button to flag a failed safety check with no diagnosed causes to the maintainer coordinator team.
4. When the cause of the failure is clear, select the 'Record or edit diagnosed failed safety check' button.
5. On the pop-up dropdown box, select the exact cause of the failure according to the 'Failures' document and a description in English and Urdu of what exactly happened and was found by you. Please ensure you include as many details as possible to ensure that the maintainer knows what to discuss with the customer. For example 'there was exposed copper on the outer foil of a live cable'.
6. Press 'Save' in the top righthand
